bills.title: Early Childhood Education and Care (Three Day Guarantee) Bill 2025

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-06.28.1) to an [original motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-06.27.1), which means it was unsuccessful. ### Amendment text > *Omit "be referred immediately to the Education and Employment Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 21 March 2025", substitute "not be referred to a committee".* ### Original motion text > *At the end of the motion, add: "and the [Early Childhood Education and Care (Three Day Guarantee) Bill 2025](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7316) be referred immediately to the Education and Employment Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 21 March 2025".*
question: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-06.28.1) to an [original motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2025-02-06.27.1), which means it was unsuccessful. ### Amendment text > *Omit "be referred immediately to the Education and Employment Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 21 March 2025", substitute "not be referred to a committee".* ### Original motion text > *At the end of the motion, add: "and the [Early Childhood Education and Care (Three Day Guarantee) Bill 2025](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7316) be referred immediately to the Education and Employment Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 21 March 2025".*
